interpretation.text: Two local readings conflict for this row. (a) Literal CDS reading: Note (3) applies to every 1.0 in e_Sigma*, so stars row 2 carries an upper-limit marker (P53 label UPPER_LIMIT_NOTE3; bundle upper_limit_marker true; value present). (b) The secondary note reports that the primary paper's printed example (Appendix E) lists populated values with RMS 1.0, concludes that NGC 3198's populated stellar row with RMS 1.0 "is not a limit flag", and says HI limits are encoded as a blank density with 1.0 in the error slot. Schema fact relevant to both: Sigma* and e_Sigma* carry no "?" null flag (lines 175-176), so a stellar entry is never blank and the blank-density encoding described in (b) cannot occur for stars; Note (3) on e_Sigma* is the stellar-limit encoding the ReadMe gives. The P53 freeze already records this as SEMANTIC_CONFLICT_PENDING_DISTINCT_REVIEW with Gaussian_likelihood null. Neither reading is adopted.
